article.headline: Wagner defeats Saint Francis (PA) 65-56
article.description: — Travis Gray had 27 points in Wagner's 65-56 victory over Saint Francis (PA) on Saturday.

categories.description: Wagner Seahawks @ Saint Francis Red Flash

event.description: Wagner Seahawks @ Saint Francis Red Flash

keywords: Wagner Seahawks @ Saint Francis Red Flash
article.story: LORETTO, Pa. -- — Travis Gray had 27 points in Wagner's 65-56 victory over Saint Francis (PA) on Saturday. Gray added 11 rebounds for the Seahawks (11-16, 6-10 Northeast Conference). Zion Russell finished with 21 points, six rebounds and three steals coming off the bench for the Red Flash (6-22, 4-11). The loss is the eighth straight for Saint Francis. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
